title: The doxie pups are reminding you to take the turkey out of the freezer
author: ElenaSWVA
text: Good Sunday morning from SW Virginia. The doxie pups are reminding you to take the turkey out of the freezer and put it in your fridge so it’s defrosted by Thanksgiving 🦃
blurb: Two long-haired doxies, one chocolate and one black-and-tan, are curled up together in their bed with very serious faces. Their human says they're on Thanksgiving duty, reminding everyone to move the turkey from the freezer to the fridge.
